setup: 15 ground-truth attack hosts vs 10 benign control hosts; undirected recursive-CTE traversal; reach = path to malicious/ioc node exists AND ioc node in neighborhood
findings: Perfect separation: benign hosts never reach IOC nodes within 4 hops.
Attack rate caps at 0.333 because only 5/15 synthetic incident scenarios include C2 traffic to flagged IP ranges; remainder are file/privilege chains with no network egress.
Fixed traversal bug: neighborhood LIMIT without ORDER BY was non-monotonic in depth (arbitrary node truncation); now truncates nearest-first by BFS depth.
